delete.description:
Remove the API and everything it owns (builds, documents, tags, evals, release
notes, package meta, jobs, display name) in one transaction, with an audit row.
`confirm` must be the API id. 409 api_in_use (with `pinnedBy`) while official or
unreleased models/sets pin its builds; `force: true` retires them first
(official -> superseded, unreleased -> discarded).

post.description:
The web's relation editor: change relation designs (kind, cardinality, embed/ref,
confirmed) of the latest version; a new version is stored (unlisted without the token,
unreleased with it). Only designs whose fields exist in the members pass (see each
relation's `editableOptions`); anything else is a revision with Claude (422).

Make an unreleased set official AND release its unreleased members (listed in
`releasedMembers`). 409 while a relation is undecided.

schema.title: Response Release V1 Model Sets  Set Id  Release Post
Response Revise V1 Model Sets  Set Id  Revise Post

get.description:
Official models (the latest released version of each). With the maintainer token,
`visibility=unreleased|superseded|all` lists the others too. Newest first.
APIs with a published build (the ones a model can be built from).

post.description:
engine=claude (default without the token): start a session your Claude fills; the
model is stored unlisted (unreleased with the token). engine=server (maintainer token;
default with it): Plume generates the model with its LLM → 202 with the job; the model
is stored unreleased. `ready` returns an existing model only when the caller may see it
(official; unreleased too for a maintainer).

get.description: A server-side generation job (maintainer).

Server-sent events; `event:` = queued|started|context|round|refused|accepted|failed|
done. Resume with the Last-Event-ID header. The stream ends after `done`.

post.description:
TRANSITION: the latest version of each model started with one of these old owner
keys (POST so the keys stay out of URLs and logs), plus `collections`: the "My models"
links those keys became. Use GET /v1/collections/{id} from now on.

get.description: For pollers: `submitted` with the snapshot id once a draft was accepted.
Index of the session's evidence (documents per API with field counts).

schema.title: Response Context V1 Models Sessions  Session Id  Context Get

post.description:
Validate and store a draft: unlisted without the token, saved into the user's "My
models" link (`collection`; a new one when omitted or unknown, returned as
`collection: {id, url, created, note?}`), unreleased with it. `basedOn` makes it the
next version of that model when you may add to it.

get.description: Fields of the concept's documents in one API (or of `doc` ids), paged by size.

schema.title: Response Evidence V1 Models Sessions  Session Id  Evidence Get

post.description:
Concepts the selected APIs document, best first, paged and filtered (see the request
fields). Deterministic: no LLM.

Concepts related to one concept in these APIs, with relation candidates taken
only from documented evidence (nested arrays, sub-resources, id fields whose
description names the target, model references), each cited per API, and the
designs that evidence supports. Different names (variant / variation) appear only as
`aliases` for the user to accept. Deterministic: no LLM.

schema.title: Response Suggest Related Concepts V1 Models Suggest Related Post

get.description:
A model (ModelSnapshot in the web client): official and unlisted ones for anyone with
the id; unreleased ones with the maintainer token (404 otherwise).

schema.title: Response Get Model V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Get

post.description: Throw away an unreleased model. 409 unless it is unreleased.

schema.title: Response Discard V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Discard Post

get.description:
What newer docs mean for this model: per mapping, the visible changes (confirmed
or likely, not wording-only) of the builds published since its pinned ones.

schema.title: Response Model Impact V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Impact Get

post.description:
Make an unreleased model official (listed publicly). 409 unless it is unreleased.
``supersedes``: official models of the same concept (from /supersedable) that this one
replaces: they stay readable by id with supersededBy, and leave the lists. 409 when an
id is not one of them.

schema.title: Response Release V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Release Post

post.description:
A session on the current builds with this model as the starting draft. Submit with
basedOn to make a new version (an official model revised without the token becomes a new
unlisted model based on it).

get.description:
Official models of the same concept (case-insensitive) over ANY API set that a
release of this model may supersede, newest first. covered: its APIs are a subset of
this model's. Offer them; nothing is superseded unless release names it.

schema.title: Response Supersedable V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Supersedable Get

post.description:
An official model retires older official models of its concept (ids from
/supersedable): they stay readable by id with supersededBy and leave the lists. 409
when this model is not official or an id is not a candidate; nothing changes then.

schema.title: Response Supersede V1 Models  Snapshot Id  Supersede Post
